title: Fix IsDisposeCall check in DisposableMethodImplAnalyzer
body:
Updates `IsDisposeCall` in `DisposableMethodImplAnalyzer` to require non-static and non-generic method symbols, and updates the invocation check in `AnalyzeAndUpdateAsyncDisposableMemberSet` to call `IsDisposeCall` while preserving instance unwrapping logic.
